title: Jarvis
tagline: x402 to pay or buy any service, request an uber from chatgpt or any other agent

prizes.title: Best integration using the MATE Metaprotocol

description: Agents can not buy anything, if you go to chatgpt and asking to request an uber or to buy something from amazon it is not possible, so with jarvis using x402 you can request uber buy on amazon and give any agent the commerce capabilities. With this new agents and x402 we open a lot of new flows.
how_its_made: By using x402 and the browser mcp, the agent is smart enough to understand different tasks from buying something on amazon to request and uber. Agents need real tools and pay for the things they need, so now with x402 it is possible and also by using evvm it is a gasless and frictionless experience.
